questions.stem: Two angles on a straight line add up to:
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line are supplementary and always sum to $180°$.

questions.stem: Two straight lines cross at a point. One of the angles formed is $65°$. What is the vertically opposite angle?
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are always equal. The angle directly opposite the $65°$ angle is also $65°$.

questions.stem: Three angles meet at a point. Two of them are $110°$ and $85°$. What is the third angle?
questions.explanation: Angles around a point sum to $360°$. The third angle is $360° - 110° - 85° = 165°$.
